name: Barbara Plank

affiliations.role: Head of MaiNLP; Professor, LMU Munich

bio: Barbara Plank is a professor and chair for AI and Computational Linguistics at LMU Munich, where Plank heads the MaiNLP lab and co-directs the Center for Information and Language Processing. Research focuses on human-facing NLP: making models robust to language variation, fairer, and aware of variation in human labels.
known_for: Head of the MaiNLP lab at LMU Munich
